title: Operations Start Action Permission Consistency

items.action: start an operation from the Operations page

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.operations.execute permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing StartOperationUseCase authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; only the Operations-page start action is aligned with the existing execute authorization.

audit.reason: Existing operation-start audit behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The /operations route still requires fair_crm.operations.read; this change only gates the start mutation action.

notes: OperationsPage previously rendered and invoked the start row action based only on operation state, while StartOperationUseCase requires fair_crm.operations.execute. The start entry point now hides and fails closed without execute permission. Cancel remains outside this focused change.
